about.en: The Index (INDEX) is a token on Robinhood Chain at 0x56910D4409F3a0C78C64DD8D0545FF0705389870 whose trades carry a 3% ETH fee; the protocol uses the fees to buy tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain and distributes them pro rata to wallets holding at least 10,000 INDEX. The distributions are tokenized stocks, not brokerage shares, and the token itself is not backed by stocks.
